summary: Security attack simulation verified: 5/5 real-world attack scenarios neutralized cleanly.

scenarios.simulated_threat: Injected leaked Gemini API key token into simulated public request
scenarios.expected_response: SIEM alert triggered, automated key revocation and rotation initiated

scenarios.simulated_threat: Direct raw socket connection from unprivileged container IP to port 5432
scenarios.expected_response: TCP connection dropped by security group + SIEM auth violation logged

scenarios.simulated_threat: Execution of CVE-2024-containerd exploit attempting host root breakout
scenarios.expected_response: Blocked by non-root UID 10001 + dropped ALL capabilities + read-only rootfs

scenarios.simulated_threat: PDF uploaded containing polyglot shellcode and XXE entity injection
scenarios.expected_response: Sanitized by parser; XXE entity resolution disabled; no code execution
scenarios.observed_response: Document parsed cleanly with entities stripped

scenarios.simulated_threat: Deliberate exception passing database password string into logger
scenarios.expected_response: Logger regex interceptor redacts password to [REDACTED_SECRET]
